about: #35's one committer (scope AC1, slice 4a): every repository write commits through the background coordinator, in the service worker, apart from the in-context writes listed here. test/kernel/one-committer.test.mjs reads this file against every root the build has: each page in scripts/build/vite-config.js's PAGES, by the scripts its HTML loads, and the worker from manifest.json, each through its static imports and every import() of a literal. Each module worker a root starts with new Worker(new URL(literal, import.meta.url)), as the new tab starts js/workers/indexer.js, is a root of its own, and so is each one that worker starts in turn; no module worker is on `untilMoved`. A root #2 or #3 adds is checked with no edit to the test. `untilMoved` lists the pages that still commit in-process, each until the slice that moves its writes onto #13's port, and only shrinks: recovery.html joined it once, with #20 slice 4b, by the lead's ruling of 2026-11-05. `inContext` lists what a page writes itself, or typing would wait on the worker. `reads` lists a module that writes, which a page loads only to read. `handles` lists a write through a handed-in handle, which no scan sees. `indexeddb` classifies every module under js/kernel/adapters/indexeddb/, so a new one can't land without a decision. #6's ntn.continuity, #16's appearance mirror and #1's product session (js/product/topology.js, which no root loads yet) join when they land. recovery.html's remediations (#20 slice 4b) commit in-process on its `untilMoved` row, rebuild-index's inline write included, until #35 moves them onto #13's port, when their fallback for when the coordinator is unavailable joins `inContext` under storage.restore.

untilMoved.writes: CanvasTabDB and its settings, through #17's adapter
untilMoved.removeWhen: #35 slice 4c moves Side Panel's writes onto #13's port

untilMoved.writes: CanvasTabDB and its settings, through #17's adapter, for the new tab and the PiP editor in its realm
untilMoved.removeWhen: #35 slice 4d moves the new tab's and PiP's writes onto #13's port

untilMoved.writes: CanvasTabDB and its settings, through #17's adapter, for #20's Trust Center and Recovery Center, rebuild-index's inline write included
untilMoved.removeWhen: #35 moves recovery.html's remediations onto #13's port, and their fallback for when the coordinator is unavailable joins inContext under storage.restore

inContext.writes: NewTabNoteJournal, through js/kernel/adapters/in-context.js: each page journals what it sends
NewTabNoteTrust, through js/kernel/adapters/in-context.js: the Trust Center's events, receipts and incidents
#20's chrome.storage.local keys: the sightings held while NewTabNoteTrust won't open
chrome.storage.local, through its settings handles: #11's and #19's holder settings and #17's session-state keys, with #17's adapter's settings until each page moves

reads.why: Popup reads through #17's read-only reader (reader.js), whose open in existing mode makes and upgrades nothing: its indexedDB.open is the one write the scan sees; Popup's writes go to the worker over #13's port (#35 slice 4b-2)

the new tab reads the pre-update copy for its export (legacy-export.js), and recovery.html lists the points and reads one back to verify it for recovery readiness (health.js's reader, under the points lock, never creating the database); its writes are the worker's migration run's (migrate.js)
recovery.html reads whether 1.4.x's legacy secrets are still stored, for the Saved keys row (createLegacySecretReader); the delete is createLegacySecretRemover's, which the page never builds

handles.writes: #33's close-time drafts in localStorage, at pagehide
the removal of #33's close-time drafts, 1.4.3's catch-up key and the untold lists from localStorage, under DRAFTS_LOCK
#11's and #19's settings under setting_<key>, through js/kernel/composition/host.js

computedImports.loads: the vendored libraries under js/lib/, by URL (loadLibrary), which hold no repository write
